lines.text: A man of noble birth went to a distant country and gave ten servants ten minas.
His subjects sent a delegation saying they did not want him to rule, but he returned as king.
The first servant's mina produced ten more, and the master gave him authority over twenty cities.
The servant who hid his mina in a piece of cloth lost it, and it went to the one with five minas.
The master ordered his enemies, who were unwilling for him to rule over them, to be slain in front of him.
